sections.title: Computer Vision Applications for Los Angeles Organizations
sections.description: Production-grade CV solutions for LA's leading industries.

blocks.heading: Entertainment and Post-Production CV
paragraphs: For Disney, Universal, Warner Bros., Netflix LA, and the LA post-production community:

VFX quality automation: CV for automated visual effects quality inspection — detecting rendering artifacts, compositing errors, color inconsistencies, and visual anomalies in VFX shots before they reach editorial review. At studios producing hundreds of VFX-heavy shots per week, automated quality checks before human supervisor review significantly compress post-production cycles.

Product placement and brand detection: CV for identifying product placements and branded content in film and television footage — enabling studios and streaming services to accurately catalog and monetize their product placement inventory and ensure contractual placement obligations are fulfilled.

Content moderation and clearance: CV for identifying clearable vs. problematic visual content in footage — detecting logos, artwork, and signage that require licensing or clearance in background elements of film and television productions.
Cost: $55,000–$155,000 | Timeline: 12–24 weeks | CCPA-anonymous design

blocks.heading: Wildfire Monitoring and Risk Assessment
paragraphs: Post the January 2025 LA wildfires, wildfire CV is one of the most commercially significant new AI applications in Southern California:

Real-time wildfire detection from aerial imagery: CV detecting active wildfire ignitions from aerial and satellite imagery — early detection from CAL FIRE's aerial surveillance program and private drone networks for LA's fire-prone hillside communities.

Wildfire progression tracking: CV estimating wildfire perimeter growth rate and direction from multi-temporal aerial and satellite imagery — providing incident commanders and community evacuation planners with near-real-time fire perimeter intelligence.

Post-fire damage assessment: CV for damage assessment from aerial and satellite imagery following LA wildfires — identifying structures destroyed, damaged, and undamaged for insurance, government relief, and rebuilding prioritization.
Cost: $65,000–$175,000 | Timeline: 14–26 weeks | CAL FIRE data context

blocks.heading: Medical Imaging AI
paragraphs: For Cedars-Sinai Medical Center, UCLA Health, and LA's academic medical centers:

Cardiology imaging AI: CV for Cedars-Sinai's world-leading heart institute — echocardiogram automated interpretation, coronary artery calcium scoring from CT, and cardiac MRI segmentation for Cedars-Sinai's enormous cardiovascular program volume.
Oncology imaging AI: CV for tumor detection, measurement, and characterization for UCLA Health's and Cedars-Sinai's large cancer programs.
Dermatology imaging AI: CV for skin lesion classification from clinical photography — particularly relevant in LA's sun-intensive climate where skin cancer incidence is above national averages.
Cost: $70,000–$190,000 | Timeline: 14–28 weeks | HIPAA + CCPA + CMIA

blocks.heading: Retail and CPG Visual Analytics
paragraphs: For LA's large grocery and specialty retail market:

Shelf analytics for diverse SKUs: CV for the diverse product mix of LA's grocery and specialty retail market — the ethnic food aisles, specialty ingredients, and diverse product categories that LA's multicultural consumer market requires create shelf analytics challenges that simpler national models don't address.

Loss prevention for LA urban retail: Anonymous person behavior detection for LA's high-shrink urban retail environments — without facial recognition, using behavioral signals and item-selection patterns instead.
Cost: $55,000–$145,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks | CCPA anonymous design

sections.title: LA Computer Vision Regulatory Context
sections.description: Key compliance considerations for Los Angeles CV development.

blocks.heading: CCPA for all consumer CV
paragraphs: Any computer vision system processing California consumer imagery must comply with California's CCPA — facial recognition and biometric feature extraction require CCPA sensitive personal information consent. ClickMasters designs all LA consumer CV as anonymous aggregate analytics by default.

blocks.heading: SAG-AFTRA AI and performer imagery
paragraphs: Entertainment CV that processes actor and performer imagery must comply with SAG-AFTRA's AI provisions and California AB 2602 (digital replica consent) — ClickMasters designs entertainment CV that processes performer imagery with these constraints.
